disclaimer: Generated inspection protocol: it lists what a technician must physically check. It does not verify the product; results come only from the physical inspection and its evidence.

parameters.title: Chassis & Engine Number
parameters.description: Match the stamped chassis/VIN and engine numbers with the registration.
instructions: Locate the chassis/VIN plate and engine number
Compare both with the registration certificate
Photograph both
parameters.expectedResult: Chassis/VIN and engine numbers match the registration.

parameters.title: Registration Plate
parameters.description: Confirm the number plate matches the documents and is legible.
instructions: Compare front and rear plates with the registration certificate
Check both are fixed and legible
parameters.expectedResult: Plates match the documents and are legible.

parameters.title: Brakes
parameters.description: Check brake feel and the parking brake with the vehicle stationary; any road test is by a qualified driver only.
instructions: With the engine running and the vehicle stationary, press the brake pedal: it should be firm, not sink
Check the parking brake holds the vehicle on level ground
Check for brake warning lights
Any moving brake test must be done by a qualified, licensed driver at walking pace in a closed, safe area
parameters.expectedResult: Firm pedal, parking brake holds, no brake warnings.

parameters.title: Dashboard Warning Lights
parameters.description: Check no warning lamps remain lit after start-up.
instructions: Turn the ignition on and confirm the warning lamps light briefly
Start the engine and confirm they go out
Record any lamp that stays on
parameters.expectedResult: No warning lamps lit with the engine running.

parameters.title: Lights & Indicators
parameters.description: Test all exterior and interior lights.
instructions: Test headlights on low and high beam, tail lights, brake lights, indicators and hazard lights
Test reverse lights and number-plate lights
parameters.expectedResult: Every light works.

parameters.title: Seats & Seatbelts
parameters.description: Count the seats and test every seatbelt.
instructions: Count usable seats and compare with the declared seating capacity
Pull and latch every seatbelt; check each retracts and locks on a sharp pull
Check seat adjusters and headrests
parameters.expectedResult: Seat count matches the claim; every belt latches and locks. Declared: 7.
parameters.verificationInstruction: Count usable seats with belts and compare with the claim and the registration certificate.
parameters.reason: Category baseline for vehicle (vehicle template). Provider claim: Seating Capacity = 7, declared by the provider.

parameters.title: Tyres & Spare Wheel
parameters.description: Check tread, sidewalls and pressures, including the spare.
instructions: Measure tread depth on each tyre with a gauge
Inspect sidewalls for cuts and bulges
Check pressures with a gauge
Check the spare wheel, jack and wheel spanner are present
parameters.expectedResult: Tread at or above the legal minimum on every tyre; no sidewall damage; spare present.

parameters.title: Horn & Wipers
parameters.description: Test the horn, wipers and washers.
instructions: Sound the horn
Run the wipers at every speed and the washers
parameters.expectedResult: Horn, wipers and washers work.

parameters.title: Windscreen, Windows & Mirrors
parameters.description: Check glass and mirrors give a clear, safe view.
instructions: Check the windscreen for cracks in the driver's view
Check every window operates
Check mirrors are intact and adjustable
parameters.expectedResult: No cracks in the driver's view; windows and mirrors work.

parameters.title: Safety Kit
parameters.description: Check the safety equipment carried in the vehicle.
instructions: Check the warning triangle, first-aid kit and, where carried, a fire extinguisher within its service date
parameters.expectedResult: Safety kit present and in date.

parameters.title: Exterior Bodywork
parameters.description: Inspect every body panel.
instructions: Walk around the vehicle and inspect every panel
Note dents, scratches, rust and paint mismatch
Photograph all four sides and every damage point
parameters.expectedResult: Bodywork condition recorded; no damage beyond the declared condition.

parameters.title: Automatic Transmission
parameters.description: Check gear selection with the vehicle stationary and the brake held.
instructions: With the engine running and the brake firmly held, move the selector through P, R, N and D
Confirm each position engages smoothly without clunks or delay
Confirm no transmission warning appears
Any driving check is by a qualified driver at low speed in a safe area
If the selector has a manual (+/−) mode, check it changes gear indication while stationary
parameters.expectedResult: Each gear engages promptly and smoothly; no warnings.
parameters.reason: Conditional check: transmission = automatic (claim: Transmission = Automatic). Product-specific (toyota_innova): The Innova is a 7/8-seat MPV with second-row slide/tumble seats and rear roof AC vents.

parameters.title: Engine Start & Idle
parameters.description: Start the engine and observe the idle with the vehicle parked.
instructions: With the vehicle parked in neutral or park, start the engine
Observe a steady idle and listen for knocking or misfire
Look for excessive smoke from the exhaust
Do not rev the engine hard
parameters.expectedResult: Starts promptly, steady idle, no abnormal noise or smoke.

parameters.title: Second-Row Seats & Third-Row Access
parameters.description: Check the second-row seats slide and tumble so passengers can reach the third row.
instructions: Slide and recline each second-row seat
Tumble the second-row seat and confirm it locks back into place
Check the third-row seats and their belts
parameters.expectedResult: Seats move and lock securely; third row accessible.
parameters.reason: Product-specific (toyota_innova): The Innova is a 7/8-seat MPV with second-row slide/tumble seats and rear roof AC vents.

parameters.title: 12V Battery
parameters.description: Check the starter battery from the outside.
instructions: Check the battery is secured
Look for corrosion on terminals and a cracked case
Do not touch both terminals or disconnect anything
parameters.expectedResult: Secured, no corrosion or damage; vehicle starts.

parameters.title: Air Conditioning
parameters.description: Confirm the air conditioning cools in every zone.
instructions: Run the AC on maximum cooling with the engine running
Check cold air from every vent, including rear vents where fitted
Check the blower works at every speed
Check the rear roof-mounted AC vents and the rear blower control
parameters.expectedResult: Cold air from all vents at every blower speed.
parameters.reason: Conditional check: hasAC = true (profile: toyota_innova). Product-specific (toyota_innova): The Innova is a 7/8-seat MPV with second-row slide/tumble seats and rear roof AC vents.

parameters.title: Fluid Levels & Leaks
parameters.description: Check fluid levels and look for leaks with the engine off and cool.
instructions: With the engine off and cool, check engine oil on the dipstick and coolant in the expansion tank
Check brake and washer fluid reservoirs
Look under the vehicle for fresh drips
Never open a hot coolant cap
parameters.expectedResult: Levels within marks; no active leaks.

parameters.title: Transmission
parameters.description: Verify the provider's declared transmission.
instructions: Confirm the transmission type from the gear selector and registration documents.
Record the observed value next to the claimed value
parameters.expectedResult: Matches the declared value: Automatic
parameters.verificationInstruction: Confirm the transmission type from the gear selector and registration documents.
parameters.reason: Provider claim: Transmission = Automatic, declared by the provider.

parameters.title: Odometer Reading
parameters.description: Record the odometer reading.
instructions: Read the odometer with the ignition on
Photograph the reading
parameters.expectedResult: Reading recorded and consistent with any declared figure.

parameters.title: Fuel Level
parameters.description: Record the fuel level at handover.
instructions: Read the fuel gauge with the ignition on
Photograph the gauge
parameters.expectedResult: Fuel level recorded.

parameters.title: Registration, Insurance & Permits
parameters.description: Check the vehicle's legal documents are valid for the hire period.
instructions: Check the registration certificate
Check insurance validity dates
Check pollution certificate and any commercial permit or fitness certificate required for hire use
parameters.expectedResult: All documents present, in the vehicle's name as listed, and valid through the hire period.

parameters.title: Interior Condition
parameters.description: Inspect upholstery, trim and floor.
instructions: Check seats for tears and stains
Check the dashboard, door trims and floor mats
Note odours
parameters.expectedResult: Interior clean and consistent with the declared condition.

parameters.title: Declared Condition Grade
parameters.description: Compare the item's overall state with the condition the provider declared.
instructions: Read the declared condition grade
Decide whether the observed state matches, exceeds or falls short of it
Record the grade you would assign
parameters.expectedResult: Observed condition matches the declared grade.
parameters.verificationInstruction: Grade the observed condition and compare it with the declared grade.
parameters.reason: Category baseline for vehicle (vehicle template). Provider declared condition: Good.
